title: Content Pool: Praxis Suriya (Coralie Suriyapperuma)
subtitle: Homepage first. Existing site, 90-day programme client. Health client, HWG mode. Ingelheim, with Mainz, Wiesbaden and Bingen.

findings.text: The core place is a small market. 'massage ingelheim' has 480 searches a month, 'naturheilpraxis ingelheim' 210, 'heilpraktiker ingelheim' 140. Mainz and Wiesbaden are much larger: 'massage mainz' 4,400, 'massage wiesbaden' 5,400. Her own queries (90 days) show this. Ingelheim: 1,321 impressions, 30 clicks. Mainz: 1,363 impressions, 10 clicks. Wiesbaden: 872 impressions, 2 clicks. Bingen: 1 impression. The volume sits in Mainz and Wiesbaden. Most clicks come from Ingelheim queries. Keep the existing place pages and add local proof. Do not add new place pages.

Massage carries the visibility. Massage queries bring 2,804 of 4,809 listed impressions (58 %). They also bring 29 of 57 listed clicks. The brand core (Migräne, Kopfschmerz) brings 239 impressions and 2 clicks. Nervensystem and Vagus bring 9 impressions. The keyword tool shows no volume for 'migräne', 'migräne behandlung' and 'nackenschmerzen'. It hides health terms. That is not zero demand. Autocomplete, People Also Ask and her own queries show the demand.

The brand core is open ground locally. 1 of 11 local practice sites show Migräne, Vagus or Nervensystem in a title, heading or URL. Her site says it in the H1. Google does not yet connect her to these terms. One likely reason: the baseline report shows the new pages as not indexed on 2026-09-29. Index requests followed on 2026-10-01.

Text depth is not the gap. Her homepage has {bench.own} words. The median of {bench.n} local competitor homepages is {bench.median} words. The floor from gate A0 is {bench.floor} words. She is far above the floor. The work is on trust and contact, not on more text.

Contact and proof are the gap. 7 of 11 local competitor homepages have a tap-to-call link. 0 of 62 pages of her site have one. Her number is plain text and WhatsApp is linked. She has 12 Google reviews. The leader 'Naturheilpraxis Ingelheim' has 37. Links are not the gap. Her domain has 65 referring domains. The leader has 63.

Her prices disagree on her own site. The single pain-therapy session costs 85 EUR in the hero line of /ganzheitliche-schmerztherapie/ and in a heading of /nacken-schulter/, 95 EUR in the body text and FAQ of the same pages, and 80 EUR on /kosten-abrechnung/ (an old page). One price must win before any text work.

The big competitor keywords are a trap again. Bioresonanz (14,800), Kinesiologie (22,200), Drip-Bar (4,400) and Chelattherapie (1,900) are topics of the Ingelheim competitors. Thai massage has 301,000 searches. 'thai massage ingelheim' has 390. She offers none of these. The fit gate cuts them.

She is strong where she is already named. She is first in the organic results for 'ayurveda ingelheim' (position 1) and 'ayurveda massage mainz' (position 1). She is third in the Local Pack for 'heilpraktiker ingelheim' and 'akupunktur ingelheim' (positions 3 and 3). She is not in the top 20 organic results for 'schmerztherapie ingelheim'. She is not in its Local Pack either. She is also absent from the top 20 for 'migräne behandlung heilpraktiker'. Her organic position for 'heilpraktiker ingelheim' is 18. For 'lymphdrainage ingelheim' it is 8. Protect Coralie's page /ayurveda-therapie/ (untouchable) and grow the others around it.

Most live items are already on the site. 19 items reach priority A. 16 of them have a live page. 3 still need work (price, voucher path, qualifications block). This pool is a keep-and-strengthen list. It is not a build list.

pillars.location: Core place Ingelheim is small. Mainz and Wiesbaden carry the volume and already have pages. Keep them, add local proof. Bingen stays in text until Coralie gives a travel time and a local fact. Name and schema must match across site, Google profile and directories.
pillars.service: Every service is on the site. The work is order and clarity: three entry offers first, one price each, the 12-week programme further down. Fix the 85/95/80 EUR price conflict. Protect Coralie's own page. Cut Thai massage, Faszien, Shirodhara, Bioresonanz and similar.
pillars.brand: Migräne and Nervensystem are the difference. Method in three sentences, her story, fewer names and fewer prices at once (her own feedback of 2026-10-06). Use du everywhere.
pillars.authority: Qualifications are verified and strong (10 stations with year and school). Reviews are the weak point: 12 against the leader. Press (Allgemeine Zeitung 2023) is not used. Patient quotes need consent. Directories go to the backlink workflow.

decisions: Pick the three entry offers for the homepage and confirm one price per offer. Coralie must also confirm the pain-therapy price (85, 95 or 80 EUR). CP-BRD-004, CP-SVC-003.
Merge the Migräne-Analyse page and the Cranio-Neuro-Analyse page. Martin gave the go on 2026-10-06. Compare both texts and read the target page before any redirect (see the sitemap). CP-SVC-010.
Bingen: keep as text only until Coralie gives a travel time and one local fact, or ask her for the facts now. CP-LOC-005.
Add a tap-to-call link next to the WhatsApp link? It adds a contact path and removes none. It needs Martin's go. CP-LOC-002.
One name for schema and directories: 'Praxis Suriya' or the Google name. Martin decided that the Google name stays. CP-LOC-008, CP-AUT-008.
Small places (Gau-Algesheim, Nieder-Olm and others): only if Coralie really treats patients there (adjacent item). CP-LOC-006.
Google Ads (paused): add negative keywords for Thai and sexualised massage searches before the campaign starts. CP-SVC-030, CP-SVC-035.
Send the client form (open facts) before copy starts. Items with status needs_client stay drafts until then.
